meta.name: iot-protocols
meta.description: Integration of advanced IoT protocols for Zephyr RTOS. Covers OpenThread mesh networking, Matter-over-Thread device development, Golioth Cloud SDK patterns, and LoRaWAN basics. Trigger when building smart home devices, wide-area sensor networks, or cloud-integrated hardware fleets.

copy.tagline: 集成 Zephyr RTOS 的多种物联网协议，如 OpenThread、Matter 和 LoRaWAN
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在用 Zephyr RTOS 开发物联网设备，需要支持多种无线协议
copy.tagline_en: Integrate IoT protocols like OpenThread, Matter, and LoRaWAN with Zephyr RTOS
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing IoT devices on Zephyr RTOS and need protocol support

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮助你配置 Zephyr RTOS 的 IoT 协议，包括 OpenThread 网状网络、Matter-over-Thread 智能家居设备、Golioth 云连接以及 LoRaWAN 传感器网络。
howto.when: 当你构建智能家居设备、广域传感器网络或需要云集成的硬件时，或提及 OpenThread、Matter、Golioth、LoRaWAN 等关键词时触发。

如何用 Matter 标准创建一个智能灯设备？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you configure IoT protocols for Zephyr RTOS: OpenThread mesh networking, Matter-over-Thread smart home devices, Golioth cloud connectivity, and LoRaWAN sensor networks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are building smart home devices, wide-area sensor networks, or cloud-integrated hardware, or when mentioning keywords like OpenThread, Matter, Golioth, LoRaWAN.

say_en.text: Help me configure the OpenThread mesh network join command.
say_en.note: Claude will provide OpenThread shell commands like ot dataset init new.

say_en.text: How to create a smart light device using Matter?
say_en.note: Claude will guide using Matter Clusters and ZAP tool.

say_en.text: Set up LoRaWAN basics and join the network.
say_en.note: Claude will give LoRaWAN config options and join flow.
